svg.title: Job Search, a Claude plugin and CLI for APM, Product Analyst and AI Product roles. Quality first job discovery: it finds jobs, throws out the ones that waste your time, scores what is left against your actual profile, and keeps a permanent record so you never apply twice. Facts: 7 weighted scoring dimensions, 3 Claude skills, 10 MCP tools, 1 SQLite database with a full audit log. Animated departures board with example rows whose status cells flip from checking to a verdict: Associate PM in Bengaluru, high priority; Product Analyst, remote, good match; AI Product Analyst, hybrid Bengaluru, high priority; Backend Engineer, rejected role; Pay to apply listing, scam, rejected; Senior Product Manager, experience too high, rejected.

div.h1: Fewer jobs. Better jobs. Never twice.
div.p: Quality first job discovery and application tracking for APM, Product Analyst and AI Product roles. It finds jobs, throws out the ones that waste your time, scores the rest against your actual profile, and keeps a permanent record.

div.span: Discovery mode: searches, scores, never submits
